items.source: A representation of an Elasticsearch document as extended Map.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 文档的扩展Map表示。

items.source: Extension to Document exposing search response related data.
items.translation: 扩展了Document，以暴露与搜索响应相关的数据。

items.source: This represents the complete search response from Elasticsearch, including the returned documents.
items.translation: 这代表来自 Elasticsearch 的完整搜索响应，包括返回的文档。

items.source: class that holds explanations returned from an Elasticsearch search.
items.translation: 包含从 Elasticsearch 搜索返回的解释的类。

items.source: meta data returned for nested inner hits.
items.translation: 嵌套内部命中返回的元数据。

items.source: A function to convert a SearchDocument async into an entity.
items.translation: 一个将 `SearchDocument` 异步转换为实体的函数。

items.source:
This package contains classes that use the new Elasticsearch client library (co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java)
to access Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 本包包含使用新的 Elasticsearch 客户端库（co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java）来访问 Elasticsearch 的类。
